# AppLovin
> AppLovin provides advertising, monetization, analytics, and app growth technologies for mobile businesses.

AppLovin offers products for user acquisition, ad monetization, measurement, and app publishing across its AppDiscovery, MAX, and related platforms. Its site includes product overviews, support resources, company information, and investor materials.

## Products
- [AppDiscovery](https://www.applovin.com/appdiscovery/): User acquisition platform for finding and scaling high-value app users.
- [MAX](https://www.applovin.com/max/): In-app bidding and mediation platform for app monetization.
- [AXON](https://www.applovin.com/axon/): Machine learning technology powering ad recommendations and optimization.
- [Array](https://www.applovin.com/array/): Creative optimization tools for building and testing mobile ad creatives.
- [Adjust](https://www.applovin.com/adjust/): Measurement and analytics solution for mobile app marketing performance.
- [Wurl](https://www.applovin.com/wurl/): CTV distribution and monetization platform for streaming publishers.

## Solutions
- [Advertise](https://www.applovin.com/advertise/): Solutions for acquiring users and growing app businesses profitably.
- [Monetize](https://www.applovin.com/monetize/): Tools for maximizing ad revenue from mobile apps.
- [Grow Your App](https://www.applovin.com/grow-your-app/): Overview of AppLovin tools for app growth and monetization.
- [Gaming](https://www.applovin.com/gaming/): Advertising and monetization solutions tailored for game developers.
- [E-commerce](https://www.applovin.com/e-commerce/): Performance advertising solutions for ecommerce brands and marketers.
- [Direct-to-Consumer](https://www.applovin.com/direct-to-consumer/): Growth solutions for direct-to-consumer advertisers.

- [Case Studies](https://www.applovin.com/case-studies/): Customer stories showing performance and growth outcomes.

## Support
- [Help Center](https://support.applovin.com/): Support portal for product documentation and troubleshooting.
- [MAX Help Center](https://support.applovin.com/hc/en-us/categories/360002147932-MAX): Support articles for MAX mediation and monetization workflows.
- [AppDiscovery Help Center](https://support.applovin.com/hc/en-us/categories/360002147912-AppDiscovery): Support articles for AppDiscovery campaign management.
- [Submit a Request](https://support.applovin.com/hc/en-us/requests/new): Contact support for account and product issues.

## Developers
- [MAX Documentation](https://developers.applovin.com/en/max/): Developer docs for integrating and configuring MAX monetization.
- [MAX SDK](https://developers.applovin.com/en/max/sdk/): SDK integration guides for supported mobile platforms.
- [Ad Units](https://developers.applovin.com/en/max/ad-formats/): Reference for supported MAX ad formats and placements.
- [Mediation](https://developers.applovin.com/en/max/mediation/): Setup guides for mediated ad network integrations.
- [Reporting API](https://developers.applovin.com/en/max/reporting-api/): API documentation for accessing monetization reporting data.
- [Test Mode](https://developers.applovin.com/en/max/testing-networks/test-mode/): Instructions for testing ad integrations before release.
